entities.summary: Mongol, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Majapahit Empire (1293–1389). Preceded by Founding and Gajah Mada's Palapa Oath. Their legacy influenced Gajah Mada swears the Palapa Oath to unite the entire Indonesian archipelago and Majapahit Decline and Islamization.
